title: Funktionale Anwendungen
slide_intent: Separate headline and reading roles by medium so readers can scan and then read comfortably.
strategic_value: Office and Screen variants can carry DB identity through documents and interfaces.
demonstration: Two rows pair Head and body families for office communication and digital applications, with weight specimens and notes.
practical_value: Choose Office for documents and Screen for digital use, then distinguish headings from body text.

content_islands.name: Office families
content_islands.spec: Pair Office Head and Office text specimens across the upper row.

content_islands.name: Screen families
content_islands.spec: Pair Screen Head and Screen Sans specimens across the lower row.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source links Screen Sans to readability at small digital sizes and Office Head to brand recognition.
reference_purposes.Application: It specifies Head families for headlines and regular-to-bold body families for reading and emphasis.
